S31.01.needs: a chat that already has a text document artifact
S31.01.note: The PDF item is shown only when the artifact is a text document; the file was not run.
steps: Open a chat that has a text document (Word-style or markdown) shown as an artifact.
Click the Download button on the artifact card (its title is Download).
Click Download as PDF in the menu.
Open the downloaded PDF and compare its text with the Expected line: a PDF of the document.
S31.01.where: Open a text document artifact in a chat reply > Download artifact (the Download button) > Download as PDF

S31.02.needs: a spreadsheet artifact in a chat
S31.02.note: Searched ArtifactPreview.tsx for PDF export; the spreadsheet/table download menu offers Download as CSV only, and PDF export is limited to text documents and presentations. The Code line pointed to apps/web/lib/server/container-files.ts:197, which is server code with no visible control.

S31.03.needs: a chat that already has a presentation artifact
S31.03.note: This menu item uses the in-browser deck export, not the E2B office template named as unfinished in the plan, so the owner step is not tested by this path.
steps: Open a chat that has a presentation (slide deck) artifact.
Click the Download button on the artifact card.
Click Download as PDF in the menu.
Open the downloaded PDF and check that it has one page per slide, compared with Expected.
S31.03.where: Open a presentation artifact in a chat reply > Download artifact (the Download button) > Download as PDF

steps: Click the Files button in the message box.
Click Upload from device and choose a PDF file.
Wait until the PDF shows in the message box, type Summarize this PDF and send.
Compare the reply with the PDF content, compared with Expected.
S31.04.where: Composer > Files > Upload from device, choose a PDF, then ask for a summary

steps: Click the Files button in the message box.
Click Upload from device and choose a PDF file.
Type a question about a fact in the PDF and send.
Check that the answer matches the PDF, compared with Expected.
S31.05.where: Composer > Files > Upload from device, choose a PDF, then ask a question about it

S31.06.note: No control of its own; the page selection is done by the server, and the Code line's quoted code was not found in the file.
steps: Attach a multi-page PDF using Files > Upload from device.
Ask a question that names one page, for example what is on page 3.
Check that the answer uses the content of that page, compared with Expected.
S31.06.where: Effect is seen in the answer to a chat question that names a page of an attached PDF

S31.07.note: There is no separate text-extraction button; it is reached by asking in chat.
steps: Click the Files button in the message box.
Click Upload from device and choose a PDF file.
Type Give me the plain text of this PDF and send.
Compare the reply with the text in the PDF, compared with Expected.
S31.07.where: Composer > Files > Upload from device, choose a PDF, then ask for its plain text

S31.08.needs: a scanned PDF with no text layer
S31.08.note: No OCR control exists; OCR runs on the server for image-only PDFs.
steps: Click the Files button in the message box.
Click Upload from device and choose a scanned PDF with no text layer.
Type Read the text in this scanned PDF and send.
Check whether the reply contains the readable text of the scan, compared with Expected.
S31.08.where: Composer > Files > Upload from device, choose a scanned PDF (image only), then ask for its text

S31.09.needs: a PDF file that contains a table
steps: Attach a PDF with a table using Files > Upload from device.
Type Extract the table from this PDF as rows and columns and send.
If a table artifact appears, click the Download button on its card.
Click Download as CSV and open the file; compare the rows and columns with Expected.
S31.09.where: Composer > Files > Upload from device, choose a PDF with a table, ask for the table, then the spreadsheet artifact > Download as CSV

S31.23.needs: a DocuSign developer app (the owner step is unfinished) and an outside account (DocuSign)
S31.23.note: The connect button label and the card's display name were not verified in the code; sending for signature was not traced past the catalog entry.
steps: Open the Connectors page from the web app.
Find the DocuSign card.
Click it and follow the connect steps.
Check that a DocuSign connection appears as connected, compared with Expected.

S31.24.needs: a chat that produced an office file
S31.24.note: Matching the preview to the exported file is not judged here; the Preview button's exact placement was not confirmed.
steps: Open a chat that produced an office file (docx, xlsx or pptx) as an artifact.
Click the Preview button on the artifact card.
Look at the preview next to the file's download option.
Compare the preview with the Expected line: a preview that matches the exported file.
S31.24.where: Generated Word, Excel or PowerPoint file in a chat reply > Preview (the Preview button on the artifact card)
